difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the cone triangle of an admissible short exact sequence with the quotient up to homotopy equivalence of triangles, and reduces arbitrary morphisms to the admissible case (statement lines 1069-1099). The proof (lines 1101-1210) is a hands-on chain-level construction: the comparison map, the homotopy inverse (s, -delta) justified by the characterizing property of delta, the displayed matrix identity exhibiting identity minus the round trip as the homotopy differential of an explicit h, and the cone-map compatibility check, followed by the admissible-replacement reduction for part (2). H2: every step is explicit, the homotopy matrices are the content, and the author displays the verification identity in full (introducing it as trivial to verify).
